jsesh.graphicExport
Class TopItemSimpleDrawer

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.graphicExport.TopItemSimpleDrawer
public abstract class TopItemSimpleDrawer
extends java.lang.Object

Base utility class which can be extended when one needs to draw a specific element.

This class is usable to implement all export filter in which some elements are exported as drawings and others are not.

Typical use of this class involves creating a subclass of it with the appropriate methods, and calling drawElement on it, and, if needed, consulting the resulting view and dimensions for layout purposes.

It would probably be better not to keep instances of TopItemSimpleDrawer.

rosmord
